title: When Does Activation Steering Change What a Model Computes From?
abstract: arXiv:2606.29522v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Activation steering can reliably change an agent's output by modifying its internal activations. Yet arriving at the same answer need not involve the same computation: behavioral equivalence does not imply mechanistic equivalence. We test whether an activation edit changes the state used in subsequent computation or biases that computation toward the desired output. In a controlled state-tracking task, trace supervision creates an editable register: changing its internal value makes the model apply the next operation to the edited state. We next ask whether widely used mean activation steering admits a similar interpretation: does steering recreate the internal configuration the model naturally uses when performing a task? If so, transplanting that activation should be effective, and steering should remain effective at the scale of the natural source-to-target activation change. Neither prediction holds in the two selected model-task

translated_title: 激活导向何时会改变模型计算所依据的内容？
translated_abstract: 激活导向可以通过修改智能体的内部激活来可靠地改变其输出。然而，得到相同的答案未必涉及相同的计算：行为等价并不意味着机制等价。我们检验激活编辑究竟是改变了后续计算所使用的状态，还是仅仅使计算偏向期望的输出。在一个受控的状态追踪任务中，轨迹监督创造了一个可编辑的寄存器：改变其内部值会使模型对编辑后的状态应用下一个操作。接下来我们探究广泛使用的均值激活导向是否可以作类似解读：导向是否重现了模型在执行任务时自然使用的内部配置？如果是这样，移植该激活应当是有效的，且导向应当在自然源到目标激活变化的尺度上保持有效。然而，在这两个选定的模型-任务组合中，这两个预测均不成立。
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献在于通过受控状态追踪任务区分激活导向的两种机制——真正编辑模型后续计算所依赖的内部状态还是仅使输出偏向期望结果——并发现行为等价不等于机制等价，均值激活导向并不能重现模型自然使用的内部配置。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is using a controlled state-tracking task to distinguish whether activation steering genuinely edits the internal state underlying subsequent computation or merely biases the output toward a desired result, showing that behavioral equivalence does not imply mechanistic equivalence and that mean activation steering fails to recreate the model's natural internal configurations.
